lines.t: I lift my heart in the morning light
Calling your name through silent skies
Every breath becomes a prayer of praise
Giving thanks in the truth that never dies
Giving thanks to God, and your name is pure worship
A melody rising from hearts made new
Every word, every tear, every song I sing
Is the life you breathe in all I do?
The world may chase its fleeting crowns
But my soul rests where mercy abounds
In the name of your love I stand
Bearing peace that no fear can drown
Giving thanks to God
And your name is pure worship
A melody rising from hearts made new
Every word, every tear, every song I sing
Is the life you breathe and all I do
Let all creation whisper your truth
Let joy awaken what sorrow once knew
For every gift returns to you again
The giver of light beyond the end
Giving thanks to God
And your name is pure worship
A river of grace that carries me through
Every moment, forever and always
My spirit lives to honor you
Thank you, Father
For everything
In Yahushua's holy name I sing
Let your peace within me stay
As I walk with you each day
Thanks for watching!
